interval_policy.source_change_budget: No fixed file-count cap for active 0.11.9 autonomous source coding; implement across as many files/tests as required for the scoped effect, while keeping changes reviewable and excluding later-release scope.
interval_policy.model_or_qa_long_job: submit once with immutable job_id/source SHA; status readback is a separate step, no duplicate dispatch
interval_policy.interruption_recovery: read PLAN + release-slices.json + Git HEAD/remote/dirty + native RUNNING/DONE/FAILED receipts and process roster before any mutation; resume only earliest OPEN step
interval_policy.checkpoint: atomic scoped commit + remote readback + immutable JSON receipt before next mutation; do not synthesize PASS on missing information
interval_policy.freeze: scoped tests then freeze clean SHA -> one full QA/vet/build + independent Sol -> release receipt; no unrelated fixes after freeze
interval_policy.defects: only security P0/P1 on active release are in critical path; other findings become deferred next release, preserving original node
interval_policy.parallel: one owner per file; one heavy Go or Codex task at a time; unfinished foreign WIP must not be staged or cleaned
interval_policy.metadata: UTC receipt/run timestamps with SGT reporting

version_policy.basis: GitHub latest published air-worker--v0.11.8 and installed 0.11.8
version_policy.reason: 0.x pre-stable existing 0.11 patch train; no unapproved promotion to 1.0.0, no reused 0.12.0
version_policy.preserve_prior_architecture_reservation: 0.12.0 remains separate architecture-cleanup target; not one of these nine micro-releases
version_policy.version_is_not_ordinal: 0.11.10 sorts numerically after 0.11.9, never use lexicographic string ordering
version_policy.guard: Tag cannot preexist, immutable installed/released version cannot be reused, numeric SemVer monotonicity required
version_policy.verified_precedence: 0.11.9 then Hermes 0.11.10-0.11.13 then Omni 0.11.14-0.11.18 then prior backlog 0.11.19-0.11.26

priority_order: 0.11.10-0.11.13: Hermes Codex + Nous Sonnet/Opus subscription semantic judges
0.11.14-0.11.18: Air OmniRouter optional executors and independently verified judges
milestone_sequence.judge_policy: native AirWorker factual exit/receipt MUST PASS, independent semantic actual upstream vendor different from executor; unsupported/unknown provider => NOT_PROVEN
milestone_sequence.permissions: Preserve existing AirLLMRouter/Codex/Claude defaults; Hermes/Omni opt-in only; no API PAYG/autotopup, no auth export, separate LPR gates for release/install/Docker/UAC/service changes
milestone_sequence.private_details: Internal Hermes and N126-N131 source branch/commit IDs and subscription route checks are retained only in private AirWorker_Wiki; public train carries milestone names, objective and gate status, not credentials or private pending node content.
